items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 I knew i had to try the game after rando
items.summary: I knew i had to try the game after randomly seeing a showcase of "Caraboo" on twitter. She is so full of whimsy and her "Snowy Hex" is a great crutch for new players who can't yet capitalize on damage multipliers stacking.
items.author: Federico Segovia
